<style>
:root{
 --bg:#031423;
 --bg2:#092d49;
 --panel:#0a3250;
 --panel2:#0c405f;
 --text:#f1f9ff;
 --muted:#9db9cd;
 --border:#18658b;
 --input:#082b47;
 --cyan:#13c9f5;
 --green:#38dfad;
 --yellow:#ffd06a;
 --red:#ff7988;
 --ring:rgba(15,167,218,.16);
 --shadow:rgba(0,0,0,.28)
}
body.light{
 --bg:#edf5fa;
 --bg2:#dcecf5;
 --panel:#ffffff;
 --panel2:#f1f8fc;
 --text:#12354e;
 --muted:#58768a;
 --border:#c2dae9;
 --input:#ffffff;
 --cyan:#087fac;
 --green:#087c58;
 --yellow:#a06a00;
 --red:#c23f52;
 --ring:rgba(8,125,170,.09);
 --shadow:rgba(16,63,94,.13)
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{
 margin:0;min-height:100%;
 font-family:"Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif
}
body{
 color:var(--text);
 background:
  radial-gradient(circle at 50% 38%,var(--ring),transparent 49%),
  linear-gradient(135deg,var(--bg),var(--bg2),var(--bg));
 transition:background .3s,color .3s
}
body:before{
 content:"";
 position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-1;
 pointer-events:none;opacity:.2;
 background:repeating-radial-gradient(
 circle at 52% 42%,
 transparent 0 120px,
 var(--border) 121px 122px,
 transparent 123px 240px)
}
.hidden{display:none!important}
button,input,select,textarea{font:inherit}
button{cursor:pointer}
.glass{
 background:var(--panel);
 border:1px solid var(--border);
 border-radius:17px;
 box-shadow:0 13px 38px var(--shadow);
 transition:background .3s,border-color .3s
}
.btn{
 min-height:44px;
 padding:11px 17px;
 color:var(--text);
 background:var(--panel2);
 border:1px solid var(--border);
 border-radius:9px;font-weight:700;
 transition:transform .18s,box-shadow .18s
}
.btn.primary{
 color:#032d43;
 background:linear-gradient(110deg,#06b9ec,#45dffc);
 border-color:#08bde9
}
.btn.danger{
 color:#fff;
 background:#a93343;
 border-color:#d15e6c
}
.btn:hover:not(:disabled){
 transform:translateY(-2px);
 box-shadow:0 6px 22px var(--shadow)
}
.btn:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}
input,select,textarea{
 width:100%;min-height:45px;
 padding:12px;background:var(--input);
 border:1px solid var(--border);
 border-radius:8px;
 color:var(--text);outline:none
}
input:focus,select:focus,textarea:focus{
 border-color:var(--cyan);
 box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--ring)
}
input::placeholder,textarea::placeholder{
 color:var(--muted)
}
option{
 background:var(--panel);
 color:var(--text)
}
label{
 display:block;font-weight:700;
 font-size:13px;margin-bottom:8px
}
.field{margin-bottom:16px}
.required{color:var(--red)}
.muted{color:var(--muted)}
.small{font-size:12px}
.logo{
 display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px
}
.logo-mark{
 width:58px;height:63px;flex:none
}
.logo-text{
 color:var(--cyan);font-size:17px;
 font-weight:900;line-height:1.12;
 letter-spacing:.03em
}
.logo-text small{
 display:block;margin-top:5px;
 color:var(--text);font-size:10px;
 letter-spacing:.1em
}
#login{
 min-height:100vh;
 display:flex;justify-content:center;
 align-items:center;padding:20px
}
.login-card{
 width:min(530px,100%);
 padding:35px
}
.login-card h1{
 font-size:28px;margin:28px 0 8px
}
.login-card p{
 font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)
}
.top{
 min-height:106px;
 display:flex;align-items:center;
 gap:22px;padding:15px 29px
}
.top .logo-mark{
 width:51px;height:56px
}
.top .logo-text{font-size:15px}
.unit{
 border-left:1px solid var(--border);
 padding-left:22px;font-size:11px;
 font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.16em;
 color:var(--cyan)
}
.top-actions{
 display:flex;align-items:center;
 gap:16px;margin-left:auto
}
.theme-btn{
 width:45px;height:45px;
 border-radius:50%;
 border:1px solid var(--border);
 background:var(--panel);
 color:var(--cyan);
 display:grid;place-items:center;
 font-size:23px
}
.theme-btn:hover{
 transform:rotate(20deg)
}
.profile{
 text-align:right;font-size:13px
}
.profile small{
 display:block;margin-top:5px;
 color:var(--muted)
}
.profile a{color:var(--cyan)}
.layout{
 display:grid;
 grid-template-columns:245px minmax(0,1fr);
 gap:14px;padding:0 14px 15px
}
.sidebar{
 min-height:calc(100vh - 120px);
 display:flex;flex-direction:column;
 padding:24px 0
}
.nav{
 display:flex;align-items:center;
 gap:15px;width:100%;
 padding:19px 20px;
 background:transparent;
 color:var(--muted);border:0;
 border-left:4px solid transparent;
 text-align:left
}
.nav i{
 width:27px;font-style:normal;
 font-size:21px
}
.nav:hover,.nav.active{
 color:var(--text);
 background:var(--ring);
 border-left-color:var(--cyan)
}
.side-bottom{
 margin-top:auto;text-align:center;
 padding:30px 10px;font-size:10px;
 letter-spacing:.24em;line-height:2;
 color:var(--cyan)
}
.main{padding:22px;min-width:0}
.crumb{
 font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);
 margin-bottom:23px
}
.heading{
 display:flex;align-items:center;
 gap:14px;margin-bottom:22px
}
.heading .symbol{
 font-size:34px;color:var(--cyan)
}
.heading h1{
 margin:0 0 5px;font-size:33px
}
.heading small{color:var(--muted)}
.hospital{
 margin-left:auto;text-align:right;
 font-weight:800;color:var(--cyan)
}
.hospital small{
 display:block;margin-top:5px;
 font-weight:400
}
.kpis{
 display:grid;
 grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
 gap:13px;margin-bottom:18px
}
.kpis.supervisor-kpis{
 grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))
}
.kpi{
 min-height:112px;padding:18px;
 display:flex;align-items:center;gap:15px
}
.kpi-icon{
 width:47px;height:47px;flex:none;
 display:grid;place-items:center;
 background:var(--ring);
 border-radius:50%;
 font-size:22px;color:var(--cyan)
}
.kpi strong{
 display:block;color:var(--cyan);
 font-size:31px
}
.kpi b{
 display:block;font-size:14px
}
.kpi small{
 display:block;color:var(--muted);
 font-size:11px;margin-top:6px
}
.panel{
 padding:23px;margin-bottom:16px;
 min-width:0
}
.panel h2{
 margin:0 0 6px;font-size:19px
}
.panel h2 span{color:var(--cyan)}
.desc{
 font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);
 margin:0 0 20px
}
.form-grid{
 display:grid;
 grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
 gap:0 20px
}
.full{grid-column:1/-1}
.buttons{
 display:flex;gap:10px;
 flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:10px
}
.form-actions{
 display:flex;justify-content:space-between;
 gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap
}
.dui-helper{
 font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);
 margin-top:5px
}
.toolbar{
 display:flex;justify-content:space-between;
 align-items:center;gap:12px;
 flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:15px
}
.toolbar input{max-width:230px}
.tablebox{
 overflow:auto;max-height:490px
}
table{
 width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;
 font-size:12px;white-space:nowrap
}
th{
 text-align:left;padding:13px 10px;
 color:var(--cyan);
 border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)
}
td{
 padding:12px 10px;
 border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)
}
tbody tr:hover{background:var(--ring)}
tbody tr{cursor:pointer}
.activity{
 display:flex;justify-content:space-between;
 gap:12px;padding:13px 0;
 border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
 font-size:13px
}
.bottom{
 display:flex;justify-content:space-between;
 align-items:center;gap:12px
}
.overlay{
 position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:20;
 background:rgba(0,12,25,.85);
 display:flex;justify-content:center;
 align-items:center;padding:20px
}
.modal{
 width:min(650px,100%);
 padding:24px;max-height:92vh;
 overflow:auto
}
.toast{
 position:fixed;right:20px;bottom:20px;
 z-index:30;max-width:430px;
 background:var(--panel);color:var(--text);
 border:1px solid var(--cyan);
 border-radius:10px;padding:16px;
 box-shadow:0 12px 36px var(--shadow);
 font-size:13px
}
.dropzone{
 padding:25px 17px;
 border:2px dashed var(--border);
 border-radius:13px;background:var(--ring);
 text-align:center;cursor:pointer;
 transition:.2s
}
.dropzone:hover,.dropzone.dragging{
 border-color:var(--cyan);
 background:rgba(19,201,245,.17)
}
.dropzone strong{
 display:block;font-size:14px
}
.dropzone small{
 display:block;color:var(--muted);
 margin-top:7px
}
.preview-file{
 margin-top:12px;
 border:1px solid var(--border);
 border-radius:12px;
 padding:12px;text-align:center
}
.preview-file img{
 display:block;max-width:100%;
 max-height:240px;margin:0 auto 10px;
 object-fit:contain;border-radius:7px
}
.pdf-preview{
 font-size:14px;padding:22px;
 text-align:center;background:var(--ring);
 border-radius:9px
}
.notice{
 border:1px solid var(--border);
 border-radius:12px;
 padding:16px;margin-bottom:16px;
 background:var(--ring)
}
.notice.warning{
 border-color:#c28e36;
 background:rgba(194,142,54,.12)
}
.notice strong{
 display:block;margin-bottom:7px
}
.notice p{
 margin:0;font-size:13px;
 color:var(--muted)
}
.status-grid{
 display:grid;
 grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);
 gap:12px;margin-bottom:18px
}
.status-item{
 background:var(--ring);
 padding:15px;border-radius:10px
}
.status-item small{
 display:block;color:var(--muted)
}
.status-item strong{
 display:block;font-size:20px;
 margin-top:6px
}
.error-overlay{
 position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:50;
 display:flex;align-items:center;
 justify-content:center;
 padding:20px;
 background:rgba(0,7,18,.93);
 backdrop-filter:blur(9px)
}
.error-panel{
 width:min(690px,100%);
 background:var(--panel);
 color:var(--text);
 border:2px solid var(--red);
 border-radius:22px;
 padding:40px;
 box-shadow:0 0 90px rgba(255,88,110,.19);
 text-align:center
}
.error-symbol{
 font-size:65px;color:var(--red);
 margin-bottom:16px
}
.error-panel h2{
 font-size:30px;color:var(--red);
 margin:0 0 15px
}
.error-panel p{
 font-size:16px;
 line-height:1.65;
 margin:0 0 26px
}
.error-panel .btn{
 min-width:210px
}
.dui-helper.ok{color:var(--green)}
.dui-helper.bad{color:var(--red)}
input.blocked{
 border-color:var(--red);
 box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(255,121,136,.15)
}
.blocked-list{
 display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px;
 margin-top:7px
}
.blocked-chip{
 font-size:10px;padding:3px 7px;
 border-radius:20px;
 border:1px solid var(--red);
 color:var(--red);
 text-decoration:line-through
}
.blocked-chip.current{
 background:var(--red);color:#fff;
 text-decoration:none
}
.notice.danger{
 border-color:var(--red);
 background:rgba(255,121,136,.1)
}
.notice.danger strong{color:var(--red)}
.search-box{position:relative}
.search-results{
 position:absolute;left:0;right:0;
 top:calc(100% + 4px);z-index:15;
 max-height:290px;overflow:auto;
 background:var(--panel);
 border:1px solid var(--cyan);
 border-radius:10px;
 box-shadow:0 14px 36px var(--shadow)
}
.search-item{
 padding:10px 13px;cursor:pointer;
 border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
 font-size:13px
}
.search-item:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.search-item small{
 display:block;color:var(--muted);
 margin-top:3px;font-size:11px
}
.search-item small.bad{color:var(--red)}
.search-item:hover,.search-item.active{
 background:var(--ring)
}
.search-empty{
 padding:12px 13px;font-size:12px;
 color:var(--muted)
}
.dropzone:focus{
 outline:none;border-color:var(--cyan)
}
.progress{
 margin-top:12px;font-size:13px;
 color:var(--cyan);font-weight:700
}
/* ===== LOGO OFICIAL ===== */
.brand-row{
 display:flex;align-items:center;
 justify-content:space-between;gap:16px
}
.brand-logo{
 width:260px;aspect-ratio:560/201;flex:none;
 background:url(data:image/png;base64,) left center/contain no-repeat
}
body.light .brand-logo{
 background-image:url(data:image/png;base64,)
}
.brand-escudo{
 width:64px;aspect-ratio:150/153;flex:none;
 background:url(data:image/png;base64,) center/contain no-repeat
}
body.light .brand-escudo{
 background-image:url(data:image/png;base64,)
}
.top .brand-logo{width:205px}
.top .brand-escudo{width:52px}
/* ===== BUSCADOR DE PACIENTES ===== */
.search-grid{
 display:grid;
 grid-template-columns:minmax(0,2fr) minmax(0,1fr);
 gap:0 18px
}
.search-meta{
 display:flex;justify-content:space-between;
 gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;
 font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);
 margin:-4px 0 12px
}
.search-meta b{color:var(--cyan)}
.chip{
 display:inline-block;font-size:10px;
 padding:3px 8px;margin:1px 2px 1px 0;
 border-radius:20px;
 border:1px solid var(--border);
 background:var(--ring);color:var(--text)
}
.btn.mini{
 min-height:32px;padding:6px 12px;font-size:12px
}
td.bad{color:var(--red)}
mark{
 background:rgba(19,201,245,.25);
 color:inherit;border-radius:3px;padding:0 1px
}
.bar{
 height:8px;border-radius:9px;overflow:hidden;
 background:var(--ring);margin-top:12px
}
.bar span{
 display:block;height:100%;width:100%;
 transform-origin:left center;transform:scaleX(0);
 background:linear-gradient(90deg,#06b9ec,#45dffc)
}
.kpi strong{transform-origin:left center}
.sync-dot{display:inline-block}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
 *{transition:none!important}
}
@media(max-width:1100px){
 .kpis.supervisor-kpis{
  grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)
 }
}
@media(max-width:720px){
 .top .brand-logo{width:150px}
 .top .brand-escudo{display:none}
 .brand-logo{width:200px}
 .brand-escudo{width:50px}
 .search-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .top{padding:12px}
 .unit,.hospital{display:none}
 .layout{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .sidebar{
  min-height:0;flex-direction:row;
  overflow:auto;padding:0
 }
 .nav{min-width:140px;padding:12px}
 .side-bottom{display:none}
 .main{padding:14px}
 .heading h1{font-size:26px}
 .form-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .full{grid-column:1}
 .kpi{padding:12px}
 .kpi strong{font-size:25px}
 .profile{font-size:11px}
 .status-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .error-panel{padding:25px}
 .error-panel h2{font-size:23px}
}

/* =========================================================
   UGM 2026 · COMPONENTES DE LAS PLATAFORMAS
   ========================================================= */

/* Fondo animado */
.bg-orbs{
 position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-1;
 overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none
}
.orb{
 position:absolute;border-radius:50%;
 filter:blur(70px);opacity:.32;
 will-change:transform
}
.orb.o1{width:440px;height:440px;background:#0aa6d8;top:-140px;left:-100px}
.orb.o2{width:380px;height:380px;background:#1b5d8f;bottom:-150px;right:-80px}
.orb.o3{width:260px;height:260px;background:#13c9f5;top:42%;left:56%;opacity:.16}
body.light .orb{opacity:.16}

.login-card{position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.shine{
 position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;left:0;width:45%;
 pointer-events:none;
 background:linear-gradient(100deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.07),transparent);
 transform:translateX(-120%)
}
.login-badge{
 display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
 margin-top:10px;padding:6px 12px;border-radius:999px;
 border:1px solid var(--cyan);color:var(--cyan);
 font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.12em
}

/* Botones con onda */
.btn{position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.ripple{
 position:absolute;width:10px;height:10px;
 margin:-5px 0 0 -5px;border-radius:50%;
 background:rgba(255,255,255,.45);pointer-events:none
}

/* Tarjetas con elevación */
.kpi,.card{transition:transform .25s,box-shadow .25s,background .3s,border-color .3s}
.kpi:hover,.card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}

/* Indicador del menú */
.sidebar.has-ink{position:sticky}
.nav-ink{
 position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:4px;height:60px;
 border-radius:0 4px 4px 0;background:var(--cyan);
 box-shadow:0 0 14px var(--cyan);pointer-events:none
}
.has-ink .nav,.has-ink .nav:hover,.has-ink .nav.active{
 border-left-color:transparent
}
.nav .badge{
 margin-left:auto;min-width:22px;padding:2px 7px;
 border-radius:999px;background:var(--red);color:#fff;
 font-size:11px;text-align:center;font-weight:800
}

/* Encabezado de página con controles */
.heading .controls{
 margin-left:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px
}
.heading .controls label{margin:0;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}
.heading .controls input{min-height:40px;padding:8px 10px;width:170px}

/* KPI con anillo */
.kpi .ring{width:47px;height:47px;flex:none}
.kpi .ring circle{fill:none;stroke-width:4}
.kpi .ring .bg{stroke:var(--ring)}
.kpi .ring .fg{stroke:var(--cyan);stroke-linecap:round}
.kpi.verde strong{color:var(--green)}
.kpi.rojo strong{color:var(--red)}
.kpi.amarillo strong{color:var(--yellow)}

/* Filtros */
.filters{
 display:grid;
 grid-template-columns:180px minmax(0,1fr) auto;
 gap:12px;align-items:end;margin-bottom:14px
}
.filters .field{margin:0}
.seg{
 display:inline-flex;border:1px solid var(--border);
 border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--input)
}
.seg button{
 border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);
 padding:12px 13px;font-weight:700;font-size:12px;
 white-space:nowrap
}
.seg button+button{border-left:1px solid var(--border)}
.seg button.on{background:var(--ring);color:var(--cyan)}

/* Pestañas por especialidad */
.tabs{
 position:relative;display:flex;gap:6px;
 overflow-x:auto;padding:4px 2px 12px;margin-bottom:12px;
 scrollbar-width:thin
}
.tab{
 position:relative;z-index:1;flex:none;
 display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
 padding:9px 14px;border-radius:999px;
 border:1px solid var(--border);background:transparent;
 color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;font-size:12px;
 transition:color .25s,border-color .25s
}
.tab:hover{color:var(--text);border-color:var(--cyan)}
.tab b{
 background:var(--ring);color:var(--cyan);
 border-radius:999px;padding:2px 8px;font-size:11px
}
.tab.active{color:#032d43;border-color:transparent}
.tab.active b{background:rgba(3,45,67,.16);color:#032d43}
.tab-ink{
 position:absolute;left:0;top:4px;height:38px;width:0;
 border-radius:999px;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;
 background:linear-gradient(110deg,#06b9ec,#45dffc);
 box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(6,185,236,.3)
}

/* Lista de citas */
.citas{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px}
.cita{
 display:grid;
 grid-template-columns:44px minmax(0,1fr) auto;
 gap:14px;align-items:center;padding:12px 14px;
 border:1px solid var(--border);border-left:4px solid var(--border);
 border-radius:13px;background:var(--panel2);
 transition:border-color .25s,transform .2s
}
.cita:hover{border-color:var(--cyan);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.cita.ok{border-left-color:var(--green)}
.cita.no{border-left-color:var(--red)}
.avatar{
 width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;
 display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none;
 font-weight:800;font-size:14px;color:#032d43;
 background:linear-gradient(135deg,#06b9ec,#45dffc);
 position:relative
}
.cita.ok .avatar{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#21c48f,#5bf0c4)}
.cita.no .avatar{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#d24b5d,#ff8d9a);color:#fff}
.cita h4{margin:0 0 5px;font-size:14px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.meta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;align-items:center;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}
.tag{
 display:inline-block;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:999px;
 border:1px solid var(--border);font-size:10px;
 font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.03em;white-space:nowrap
}
.tag.activa{color:var(--green);border-color:var(--green)}
.tag.pendiente{color:var(--yellow);border-color:var(--yellow)}
.tag.sobrecupo{color:var(--cyan);border-color:var(--cyan)}
.tag.medica{color:#c792ff;border-color:#c792ff}
.asis{display:flex;gap:6px;justify-content:flex-end}
.asis button{
 min-height:38px;padding:8px 13px;border-radius:9px;
 border:1px solid var(--border);background:transparent;
 color:var(--muted);font-weight:800;font-size:12px;
 transition:background .2s,color .2s,border-color .2s
}
.asis button:hover:not(:disabled){color:var(--text);border-color:var(--cyan)}
.asis button.si.on{background:var(--green);color:#03261a;border-color:var(--green)}
.asis button.no.on{background:var(--red);color:#fff;border-color:var(--red)}
.asis button:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}
.marcado{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:5px;text-align:right}
.lista-pie{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:12px;text-align:center}

/* Estados vacíos */
.empty{padding:42px 20px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted)}
.empty .ico{display:block;font-size:42px;margin-bottom:12px;color:var(--cyan)}
.empty b{display:block;color:var(--text);font-size:15px;margin-bottom:6px}

/* Interruptor */
.switch{
 display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:13px 15px;
 border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;
 background:var(--ring);cursor:pointer;margin:0
}
.switch input{position:absolute;opacity:0;width:0;height:0;min-height:0}
.switch .knob{
 position:relative;flex:none;width:48px;height:27px;
 border-radius:999px;background:var(--border);transition:background .25s
}
.switch .knob:after{
 content:"";position:absolute;top:3px;left:3px;
 width:21px;height:21px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;
 transition:transform .25s cubic-bezier(.3,1.4,.6,1)
}
.switch input:checked+.knob{background:var(--cyan)}
.switch input:checked+.knob:after{transform:translateX(21px)}
.switch span.txt{font-size:13px;font-weight:700}
.switch small{display:block;font-weight:400;color:var(--muted);margin-top:3px}

/* Tickets */
.tickets{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}
.ticket{
 position:relative;min-height:170px;padding:18px 14px;
 display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
 border:2px dashed var(--border);border-radius:14px;
 background:var(--ring);text-align:center;cursor:pointer;
 transition:border-color .2s,background .2s
}
.ticket:hover,.ticket.dragging,.ticket:focus{border-color:var(--cyan);outline:none}
.ticket .ico{font-size:30px;color:var(--cyan);margin-bottom:8px}
.ticket strong{font-size:13px}
.ticket small{display:block;color:var(--muted);margin-top:5px;font-size:11px}
.ticket img{max-width:100%;max-height:150px;border-radius:8px;object-fit:contain}
.ticket .quitar{
 position:absolute;top:8px;right:8px;width:30px;height:30px;
 border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--border);
 background:var(--panel);color:var(--red);font-weight:800
}
.ticket.listo{border-style:solid;border-color:var(--green)}
.req-label .required{display:none}
.req-label.on .required{display:inline}

/* Caja de cupos */
.cupo-box{
 display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;padding:16px 18px;
 border-radius:14px;border:1px solid var(--border);
 background:var(--ring);margin-bottom:18px
}
.cupo-box .num{font-size:40px;font-weight:900;color:var(--cyan);line-height:1}
.cupo-box.sin .num{color:var(--red)}
.cupo-box.medico .num{color:#c792ff}
.cupo-box p{margin:0;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.cupo-box p b{color:var(--text)}

/* Éxito */
.exito{
 position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:40;display:grid;place-items:center;
 background:rgba(0,10,22,.55);pointer-events:none
}
.exito .circulo{
 width:140px;height:140px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;
 background:linear-gradient(135deg,#21c48f,#5bf0c4);
 box-shadow:0 0 70px rgba(56,223,173,.5)
}
.exito svg{width:70px;height:70px}
.exito path{fill:none;stroke:#03261a;stroke-width:9;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}

/* Estados de solicitudes */
.estado{
 display:inline-block;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:999px;
 font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.04em;
 border:1px solid currentColor;white-space:nowrap
}
.estado.pendiente{color:var(--yellow)}
.estado.gestion{color:var(--cyan)}
.estado.observado{color:#ffa45c}
.estado.registrado{color:var(--green)}
.estado.rechazado,.estado.anulado{color:var(--red)}
.estado.validacion{color:#c792ff}

/* Bandeja de solicitudes sin verificar */
.cola{
 display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;
 padding:14px 18px;margin-bottom:16px;border-radius:14px;
 border:1px solid var(--yellow);background:rgba(255,208,106,.1)
}
.cola.urgente{border-color:var(--red);background:rgba(255,121,136,.12);
 animation:latido 2.2s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes latido{
 0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(255,121,136,0)}
 50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 6px rgba(255,121,136,.18)}
}
.cola .num{font-size:34px;font-weight:900;color:var(--yellow);line-height:1}
.cola.urgente .num{color:var(--red)}
.cola .txt{flex:1;min-width:220px;font-size:13px}
.cola .txt b{display:block;font-size:15px;margin-bottom:3px}
.tag.urgente{color:#fff;background:var(--red);border-color:var(--red)}

/* Editor de límites */
.lim{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.lim input{width:70px;min-height:38px;padding:6px 8px;text-align:center;font-weight:800}
.lim button{
 width:34px;height:38px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--border);
 background:var(--panel2);color:var(--text);font-weight:900
}
.lim input.cambiado{border-color:var(--yellow);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(255,208,106,.18)}
.tag.fecha{color:var(--yellow);border-color:var(--yellow)}
.cupo-box.ultimo .num{color:var(--yellow)}

/* Alertas de cupo */
.aviso-dia.info .aviso-ico{color:var(--cyan);background:var(--ring);border-color:var(--cyan)}
.aviso-dia.info h2{color:var(--cyan)}
.aviso-dia.bloqueo .aviso-ico{color:var(--red);background:rgba(255,121,136,.12);border-color:var(--red)}
.aviso-dia.bloqueo h2{color:var(--red)}
.aviso-dia.urgente .aviso-ico{color:var(--yellow);background:rgba(255,208,106,.12);border-color:var(--yellow)}
.aviso-dia.urgente h2{color:var(--yellow)}

/* Panel de control (supervisor) */
.dash{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px}
.span-4{grid-column:span 4}
.span-5{grid-column:span 5}
.span-6{grid-column:span 6}
.span-7{grid-column:span 7}
.span-8{grid-column:span 8}
.span-12{grid-column:1/-1}
.card{padding:20px;min-width:0}
.card-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;margin-bottom:14px}
.card h3{margin:0 0 4px;font-size:15px}
.card .sub{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin:0}
.live{
 display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;
 font-size:10px;font-weight:900;color:var(--green);letter-spacing:.14em
}
.live:before{
 content:"";width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;
 background:var(--green);animation:pulso 1.8s infinite
}
@keyframes pulso{
 0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(56,223,173,.6)}
 70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 9px rgba(56,223,173,0)}
 100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(56,223,173,0)}
}
.bars{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:11px}
.bar-row{
 display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,190px) minmax(0,1fr) 64px;
 gap:12px;align-items:center;font-size:12px
}
.bar-row .lbl{white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.track{position:relative;height:12px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--ring);overflow:hidden}
.track span{position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:999px;transform-origin:left center;transform:scaleX(0)}
.track .gen{background:rgba(19,201,245,.3)}
.track .occ{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#06b9ec,#45dffc)}
.track .full{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#d24b5d,#ff8d9a)}
.bar-row .val{text-align:right;color:var(--muted);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.legend-inline{display:flex;gap:14px;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}
.legend-inline i,.legend i{display:inline-block;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:3px;margin-right:6px;vertical-align:-1px}
.donut-wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.donut{position:relative;width:150px;height:150px;flex:none}
.donut svg{width:100%;height:100%;transform:rotate(-90deg)}
.donut circle{fill:none;stroke-width:5}
.donut .base{stroke:var(--ring)}
.donut .centro{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-content:center;text-align:center}
.donut .centro strong{display:block;font-size:28px;color:var(--cyan);line-height:1}
.donut .centro small{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.08em}
.legend{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;font-size:12px;min-width:0}
.legend b{margin-left:6px}
.hours{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:4px;height:130px}
.hours span{
 flex:1;height:100%;min-height:3px;border-radius:5px 5px 0 0;
 background:linear-gradient(180deg,#45dffc,#06b9ec);
 transform-origin:bottom;transform:scaleY(0)
}
.hours span.vacio{background:var(--ring)}
.hours-axis{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:7px}
.online{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;max-height:380px;overflow:auto}
.user{
 display:grid;grid-template-columns:42px minmax(0,1fr) auto;
 gap:12px;align-items:center;padding:10px 12px;
 border-radius:12px;background:var(--ring)
}
.user .avatar{width:42px;height:42px;font-size:13px}
.user .dot{
 position:absolute;right:-1px;bottom:-1px;width:13px;height:13px;
 border-radius:50%;border:2px solid var(--panel);background:var(--muted)
}
.user .dot.on{background:var(--green);animation:pulso 1.8s infinite}
.user b{display:block;font-size:13px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.user small{display:block;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.user .act{color:var(--cyan)}
.feed{display:flex;flex-direction:column;max-height:380px;overflow:auto}
.feed-item{
 display:grid;grid-template-columns:34px minmax(0,1fr) auto;
 gap:11px;align-items:center;padding:10px 4px;
 border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);font-size:12px
}
.feed-ico{
 width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:10px;display:grid;place-items:center;
 background:var(--ring);color:var(--cyan);font-size:15px
}
.feed-ico.ok{color:var(--green)}
.feed-ico.no{color:var(--red)}
.feed-ico.warn{color:var(--yellow)}
.feed-item b{display:block}
.feed-item small{color:var(--muted)}
.chips{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:14px}
.chip-btn{
 padding:8px 13px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--border);
 background:transparent;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;font-size:12px
}
.chip-btn b{margin-left:6px;color:var(--cyan)}
.chip-btn.on{background:var(--ring);color:var(--text);border-color:var(--cyan)}
.ticket-view{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;margin:14px 0}
.ticket-view figure{
 margin:0;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;
 padding:10px;text-align:center;min-height:150px;
 display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center
}
.ticket-view figcaption{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:8px}
.ticket-view img{max-width:100%;max-height:320px;border-radius:8px;cursor:zoom-in;object-fit:contain}
.ticket-view a{color:var(--cyan)}
.modal.wide{width:min(920px,100%)}
.detalle-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:4px 18px;font-size:13px}
.detalle-grid p{margin:5px 0}
.mini-track{height:7px;border-radius:9px;background:var(--ring);overflow:hidden;min-width:90px}
.mini-track span{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--green);transform-origin:left center}
.zoom{
 position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:60;background:rgba(0,7,18,.92);
 display:grid;place-items:center;padding:20px;cursor:zoom-out
}
.zoom img{max-width:100%;max-height:100%;border-radius:10px}

.aviso-dia{text-align:center;padding:8px 6px}
.aviso-dia .aviso-ico{
 width:84px;height:84px;margin:0 auto 14px;border-radius:50%;
 display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:44px;
 color:#c792ff;background:rgba(199,146,255,.12);
 border:2px solid rgba(199,146,255,.5)
}
.aviso-dia h2{margin:0 0 8px;color:#c792ff;letter-spacing:.04em}
.aviso-dia .dia-grande{
 display:inline-block;margin:6px 0 14px;padding:10px 18px;
 border-radius:12px;background:var(--ring);
 font-size:22px;font-weight:900;color:var(--text)
}
.aviso-dia .dia-grande:first-letter{text-transform:uppercase}
.aviso-dia p{font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;margin:0 0 10px}
.aviso-lista{
 text-align:left;margin:12px auto 18px;max-width:470px;
 padding:14px 18px 14px 34px;border-radius:12px;
 background:var(--ring);font-size:13px;line-height:1.8
}
.aviso-dia .buttons{justify-content:center}
/* Guía "¿Qué archivo va aquí?" */
.guia{
 display:grid;grid-template-columns:52px minmax(0,1fr);gap:16px;
 padding:16px 18px;margin-bottom:18px;border-radius:14px;
 border:1px solid var(--cyan);background:var(--ring)
}
.guia-ico{
 width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:14px;display:grid;place-items:center;
 color:var(--cyan);background:rgba(19,201,245,.12)
}
.guia-ico svg{width:28px;height:28px}
.guia b{color:var(--text)}
.guia>div>b:first-child{display:block;font-size:15px;margin-bottom:6px;color:var(--cyan)}
.guia p{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.55}
.guia ul{margin:0;padding-left:18px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--muted)}
.guia code{font-size:11px;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:6px;background:var(--panel2);color:var(--cyan)}

/* Íconos SVG */
svg.ico-svg{
 width:1.1em;height:1.1em;flex:none;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;
 stroke-width:1.8;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;
 vertical-align:-.18em
}
.nav i{display:grid;place-items:center}
.nav i svg,.kpi-icon svg,.theme-btn svg{width:22px;height:22px}
.symbol svg{width:36px;height:36px}
.panel h2 span svg{width:20px;height:20px;vertical-align:-3px}
.ticket .ico svg{width:40px;height:40px;stroke-width:1.5}
.aviso-ico svg{width:42px;height:42px;stroke-width:1.6}
.empty .ico svg{width:46px;height:46px;stroke-width:1.5}
.error-symbol svg{width:66px;height:66px;stroke-width:1.6}
.feed-ico svg{width:16px;height:16px}
.cupo-box .num svg{width:40px;height:40px}
.quitar svg{width:14px;height:14px}
.btn svg{width:17px;height:17px;vertical-align:-3px}

/* Encabezado fijo que se compacta con el scroll */
.top{
 position:sticky;top:0;z-index:16;
 background:var(--bg);
 background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bg) 70%,transparent);
 backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
 transition:background .3s,box-shadow .3s,min-height .3s,backdrop-filter .3s
}
.top.scrolled{
 min-height:76px;
 background:var(--panel);
 background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bg) 82%,transparent);
 backdrop-filter:blur(12px);
 box-shadow:0 10px 30px var(--shadow)
}
.top .brand-logo{transition:width .3s}
.top.scrolled .brand-logo{width:170px}
.sidebar{position:sticky;top:96px;align-self:start;min-height:calc(100vh - 110px)}
.scroll-progress{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;top:0;height:3px;z-index:30;pointer-events:none}
.scroll-progress span{
 display:block;height:100%;transform-origin:left center;transform:scaleX(0);
 background:linear-gradient(90deg,#06b9ec,#45dffc,#38dfad)
}

/* Microinteracciones */
.field label{transition:color .2s,transform .25s}
.field:focus-within label{color:var(--cyan);transform:translateX(3px)}
.nav i{transition:transform .25s}
.nav:hover i{transform:translateX(3px) scale(1.08)}
.ticket .ico{transition:transform .35s}
.ticket:hover .ico{animation:flotar 1.6s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes flotar{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-5px)}}
.ticket.dragging{background:rgba(19,201,245,.16)}
.ticket .listo-badge{
 position:absolute;top:8px;left:8px;width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;
 display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--green);color:#03261a
}
.ticket .listo-badge svg{width:16px;height:16px;stroke-width:3}
.overlay{backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}

/* Progreso del formulario */
.form-progreso{
 display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin:0 0 20px;
 font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)
}
.form-progreso .pista{flex:1;height:8px;border-radius:9px;background:var(--ring);overflow:hidden}
.form-progreso .pista span{
 display:block;height:100%;transform-origin:left center;transform:scaleX(0);
 background:linear-gradient(90deg,#06b9ec,#38dfad)
}
.form-progreso b{color:var(--cyan);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}

/* Ficha del paciente encontrado en la base */
.ficha{
 display:grid;grid-template-columns:46px minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:14px;
 align-items:center;margin-top:10px;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:13px;
 border:1px solid var(--green);background:rgba(56,223,173,.08)
}
.ficha .avatar{width:46px;height:46px}
.ficha b{display:block;font-size:14px}
.ficha small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;margin-top:3px}
.ficha .fuente{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:11px;
 color:var(--green);font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap}

@media(max-width:1100px){
 .span-4,.span-5,.span-6,.span-7,.span-8{grid-column:1/-1}
}
@media(max-width:720px){
 .sidebar,.sidebar.has-ink{position:relative;top:0}
 .top.scrolled .brand-logo{width:130px}
 .ficha{grid-template-columns:40px minmax(0,1fr)}
 .ficha .fuente{grid-column:1/-1}
 .filters{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .seg{width:100%;overflow-x:auto}
 .cita{grid-template-columns:40px minmax(0,1fr)}
 .cita .asis-wrap{grid-column:1/-1}
 .asis{justify-content:stretch}
 .asis button{flex:1}
 .tickets,.ticket-view,.detalle-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .bar-row{grid-template-columns:110px minmax(0,1fr) 54px}
 .heading{flex-wrap:wrap}
 .heading .controls{margin-left:0;width:100%}
 .heading .controls input{width:100%}
}
/* =========================================================
   ANIMACIONES V2
   ========================================================= */

/* Constelación de fondo */
#fxCanvas{position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:.9}
body.light #fxCanvas{opacity:.6}

/* Luz que sigue al cursor en tarjetas */
.kpi,.card,.panel,.login-card{position:relative}
.kpi::after,.card::after,.panel::after,.login-card::after{
 content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:inherit;
 pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity .35s;
 background:radial-gradient(420px circle at var(--mx,50%) var(--my,50%),
  rgba(19,201,245,.13),transparent 45%)
}
.luz::after{opacity:1}
.kpi.luz,.card.luz,.panel.luz{
 transition:background .3s,border-color .3s,box-shadow .25s;
 border-color:rgba(19,201,245,.45);
 box-shadow:0 18px 44px var(--shadow),0 0 0 1px rgba(19,201,245,.12),
  0 0 34px rgba(19,201,245,.12)
}

/* Borde de luz que gira en los indicadores */
@property --ang{syntax:'<angle>';inherits:false;initial-value:0deg}
.kpi::before{
 content:"";position:absolute;inset:-1px;border-radius:inherit;padding:1px;
 background:conic-gradient(from var(--ang),transparent 0 70%,
  rgba(19,201,245,.85) 82%,transparent 92%);
 -webkit-mask:linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,linear-gradient(#000 0 0);
 -webkit-mask-composite:xor;mask-composite:exclude;
 animation:girarBorde 6s linear infinite;pointer-events:none;opacity:.7
}
.kpi.verde::before{background:conic-gradient(from var(--ang),transparent 0 70%,rgba(56,223,173,.85) 82%,transparent 92%)}
.kpi.amarillo::before{background:conic-gradient(from var(--ang),transparent 0 70%,rgba(255,208,106,.85) 82%,transparent 92%)}
.kpi:nth-child(2)::before{animation-delay:-1.5s}
.kpi:nth-child(3)::before{animation-delay:-3s}
.kpi:nth-child(4)::before{animation-delay:-4.5s}
@keyframes girarBorde{to{--ang:360deg}}

/* Destello cuando cambia un número */
.kpi.destello{animation:destello .9s ease-out}
@keyframes destello{
 0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(19,201,245,.55),0 13px 38px var(--shadow)}
 100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 18px rgba(19,201,245,0),0 13px 38px var(--shadow)}
}

/* Halo pulsante del ícono de cada indicador */
.kpi-icon{position:relative}
.kpi-icon::after{
 content:"";position:absolute;inset:-4px;border-radius:50%;
 border:1px solid currentColor;opacity:0;
 animation:halo 2.8s ease-out infinite
}
@keyframes halo{0%{transform:scale(.85);opacity:.55}100%{transform:scale(1.45);opacity:0}}

/* Títulos letra por letra */
.letra{display:inline-block;transform-origin:50% 100%;will-change:transform}

/* Confeti */
.confeti{
 position:fixed;width:9px;height:14px;z-index:9999;
 pointer-events:none;border-radius:2px;margin:-7px 0 0 -4px
}

/* Botones: brillo que cruza al pasar el cursor */
.btn.primary::after{
 content:"";position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;left:-60%;width:40%;
 background:linear-gradient(100deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.35),transparent);
 transform:skewX(-18deg);transition:left .7s ease;pointer-events:none
}
.btn.primary:hover:not(:disabled)::after{left:130%}
.btn.primary:not(:disabled){box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(19,201,245,.25)}

/* Menú: ícono que salta al pasar */
.nav i,.nav svg{transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)}
.nav:hover i,.nav:hover svg{transform:translateX(3px) scale(1.15) rotate(-6deg)}

/* Filas de tablas con barra de luz */
tbody tr{transition:background .25s,transform .25s}
tbody tr:hover{background:rgba(19,201,245,.07);transform:translateX(3px);
 box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 var(--cyan)}

/* Campos con foco luminoso */
input:focus,select:focus,textarea:focus{
 box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(19,201,245,.18),0 0 18px rgba(19,201,245,.15);
 transition:box-shadow .3s,border-color .3s
}

/* Cupo de urgencia en técnicos */
.cupo-box.urgencia{
 border-color:var(--yellow)!important;
 animation:latidoUrgencia 1.8s ease-in-out infinite
}
.cupo-box.urgencia .num{color:var(--yellow)}
@keyframes latidoUrgencia{
 0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(255,208,106,.35)}
 50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 10px rgba(255,208,106,0),0 0 28px rgba(255,208,106,.2)}
}

/* Campo de texto dentro de un diálogo */
.dlg-campo{text-align:left;margin:14px 0 4px}
.dlg-campo textarea{width:100%;resize:vertical;min-height:76px}
.dlg-cuenta{display:block;margin-top:6px;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;transition:color .3s}
.dlg-cuenta.ok{color:var(--green)}

/* Supervisor: cupo de urgencia en gráficas y detalle */
.bar-row .val small{margin-left:3px;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:999px}
.bar-row .val small.urg-libre{color:var(--yellow);border:1px solid rgba(255,208,106,.5)}
.bar-row .val small.urg-usada{color:#031423;background:var(--yellow)}
.motivo-urgencia{
 grid-column:1/-1;padding:10px 12px!important;border-radius:12px;
 border:1px solid var(--yellow);background:rgba(255,208,106,.1)
}
.tag.urgente{animation:parpadeo 1.6s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes parpadeo{50%{box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(255,121,136,.6)}}

@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
 .kpi::before,.kpi-icon::after,.cupo-box.urgencia,.tag.urgente,.kpi.destello{animation:none}
 #fxCanvas{display:none}
 tbody tr:hover{transform:none}
}

/* Confirmación propia: por encima de cualquier ventana */
.overlay.confirma{z-index:70}
.confirma-caja{width:min(460px,100%)}
.confirma-caja .buttons{justify-content:center;margin-top:16px}

/* Base de Reportería: días, hora de cita y aumento 10% */
.tag.aumento{color:#3a2a00;background:var(--yellow);border-color:var(--yellow);font-weight:800}
.tag.hora{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.tag.hora svg{width:12px;height:12px}
.obs-ucc{margin-top:4px;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);
 white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;max-width:100%}
.pac-dias{margin:14px 0}
.pac-dias>b{display:block}
.pac-dias>small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;margin:2px 0 8px}
.pac-dias-lista{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:10px}
.pac-dia{
 text-align:left;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:14px;cursor:pointer;
 border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--panel2);color:var(--text);
 display:grid;gap:2px;transition:transform .2s,border-color .2s,box-shadow .2s
}
.pac-dia span{font-size:12px;text-transform:capitalize;color:var(--muted)}
.pac-dia strong{font-size:26px;color:var(--cyan);line-height:1.1}
.pac-dia small{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}
.pac-dia:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:var(--cyan)}
.pac-dia.on{border-color:var(--cyan);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(19,201,245,.25)}
</style>
